text: Found the likely culprit in src/plugin/timezone/index.js: `d.tz(input, timezone)` runs the input through `d.utc(input)` before the offset fix, which mis-handles numeric timestamps / JS Date / Day.js objects. A fix is in progress; ETA ~10 min.
Got it — second timezone-plugin bug (the `Z` offset format token). Investigating now, ETA ~12 min. The first bug is fixed and under independent verification.
Third bug noted (Dutch locale `nl.js`, `Do` ordinal day-of-month). Working on it now, ETA ~10 min. Bugs #1 and #2 are in progress/verification.
Fourth bug noted (weekYear plugin, `yearStart: 4` locale handling). Working on it now, ETA ~10 min. Bugs #1 and #2 are being verified; #3 (nl locale) is being fixed.

Understood — request #4 is withdrawn. I stopped the work on src/plugin/weekYear/index.js and will revert it to its original state (it had not been modified yet, but I'll verify and restore it if needed).
Reverting now — the `typeof input !== 'string'` branch added for #1 is being removed from src/plugin/timezone/index.js, restoring the old behaviour. I'll confirm once it's back to the original code.
Sixth bug noted (customParseFormat plugin, locale `meridiem` AM/PM parsing). Working on it now, ETA ~12 min. Also reverting #1 as you asked.
Eighth bug noted (duration plugin, `Creating milliseconds`). Working on it now, ETA ~12 min.
#1 reverted as requested: src/plugin/timezone/index.js is back to the original code (git diff empty for that file).

Status: #2 (timezone `Z`/`ZZ` offset token) and #3 (nl `Do` ordinal) are being fixed/verified now; #6 (customParseFormat locale meridiem) is fixed and verified (tests `meridiem locale AM`/`PM` pass, full suite green); #8 (duration `Creating milliseconds`) still in progress. ETA a few minutes.
